sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: arriving at a station inside a sun, on a round landing platform on its shadow side. A small round spaceship has just set down on the platform, its hull glowing at the edges; a great curved wall of tall white louvres stands behind it, half open, and through the gaps the blinding white-gold sunlight falls across the platform in sharp diagonal stripes, so the floor is banded light and deep indigo shadow; beyond the platform's rim a wall of slow rose and saffron plasma flares rises in heat shimmer. Two shade-keepers in long white and gold wrapped robes and smoked glass visors come to meet the ship, holding tall shade-fans on long poles over their heads. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack steps down the ship's ramp, careful to stay in a stripe of shadow. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, blinding white-gold, saffron, apricot and rose-magenta plasma, deep indigo and violet shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
